scripts.build: tsc -b packages/replay-schema packages/db-postgres packages/db-mongo packages/db-clickhouse apps/ingest-api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/replay-schema packages/db-postgres packages/db-mongo packages/db-clickhouse apps/ingest-api --pretty false
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres mongo clickhouse
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres mongo clickhouse
scripts.prisma:generate: npm -w @replay/db-postgres run prisma:generate && npm -w @replay/db-mongo run prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm -w @replay/db-postgres run prisma:migrate && npm -w @replay/db-mongo run prisma:push
scripts.prisma:deploy: npm -w @replay/db-postgres run prisma:deploy && npm -w @replay/db-mongo run prisma:push
scripts.role:worker: APP_ROLE=worker PORT=4002 REPLAY_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=16 INGEST_RESPONSIVE_EVAL=0 node apps/ingest-api/dist/bootstrap.js
